title: Dashboard enhancements and bug fixes
body:
* **Materialize SQL datasets (Beta)**: Dashboard materialization now covers SQL datasets in addition to local metric views, so you can materialize a dashboard's SQL datasets. See [Dataset materialization in AI/BI dashboards](/aws/en/dashboards/materialization).
* **Select multiple tables when adding a data source**: You can now select multiple tables at the same time in the **Add data source** picker when building a dashboard data model.
* **Numeric window measures**: Numeric window measures are now generally available in the low-code metric view UI. See [Local metric views](/aws/en/dashboards/manage/data-modeling/local-metric-views).
* **Global filter display in embedded dashboards**: Embedded dashboards can now show, collapse, or hide global filters by default.
* **Preserve email attachments at the size limit**: When a dashboard image and PDF together exceed the attachment size limit, scheduled emails now keep the attachments that fit instead of dropping all of them. See [Data attachments](/aws/en/dashboards/share/schedule-subscribe#email-attachments).
* **Dashboard search indexing fix**: Dashboard search now correctly indexes rich widget titles and descriptions, which previously appeared as empty strings.
* **PDF light and dark mode fix**: Fixed a bug where dashboard PDF downloads did not respect light and dark mode settings.
* **Genie Code for dashboard authoring**: New authoring capabilities and fixes for Genie Code:
  + Genie Code can now use images stored in your workspace as image widgets, not only uploaded files.
  + The dashboard canvas now stays visible while Genie Code builds datasets step by step, so you can watch widgets appear instead of seeing a blank screen.
  + Genie Code can now create dashboard materializations when you ask it to (Beta).
  + Fixed a bug where two dataset edits made at the same time could interfere with each other.
